name: @smartv/desktop
description: Smart TV desktop app (Electron) for Windows
author: SmartTV

scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartv/shared && node scripts/gen-defaults.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/publish-preload.mjs && node scripts/gen-widevine.mjs && vite build --config vite.renderer.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json
